description: Plan dated Sunflower ferry sailings, cabin fares and port access from official sources.

tools.name: source_cabins
tools.description: Read the official cabin description page. Required: route (default: osaka-beppu).

tools.name: source_conditions
tools.description: Read the official English boarding and cancellation policy.

tools.name: source_fares
tools.description: Read the official fare and seasonal-calendar page. Required: route (default: osaka-beppu).

tools.name: source_terminal
tools.description: Read the official port access page. Required: route (default: osaka-beppu).

tools.name: source_timetable
tools.description: Read the official published weekday timetable page. Required: route (default: osaka-beppu).

novel_features.name: Exact overnight itinerary
novel_features.description: Turns source boarding-date results into dated JST arrival; handles daytime E cruises without projecting ordinary timetables.

novel_features.name: Party-sensitive fare matrix
novel_features.description: Presents every source-eligible cabin fare for the entered party/vehicle without hand-made fare arithmetic.

novel_features.name: Seasonal date comparison
novel_features.description: Filters bounded published date ranges with explicit coverage and special sailing warnings.

novel_features.name: Cabin occupancy evidence
novel_features.description: Extracts source room occupancy so agents can distinguish dormitory capacity from private room occupancy.

novel_features.name: Terminal-aware port planning
novel_features.description: Keeps Osaka Terminal1 and Terminal2 distinct with concise source address/access/checkin evidence.

novel_features.name: Condition-aware handoff
novel_features.description: Preserves source cancellation/baggage and quote assumptions with explicit missing English day-before band.
